## Hi, I'm Emery 👋

I came to data science from sociology (the sociology of gender and sports in particular). 
What keeps me here is solving difficult puzzles and the knowledge we can glean from data about 
the world around us.

At Willamette my focus has been data governance and translation into actionable insights. 
My [capstone](capstone.qmd) is where that comes together.

### Beyond the terminal

- 🌲 I play rugby and also enjoy artistic pursuits (painting, drawing, and photography) in my free time
- 📚 My data science-related book recommendations are *Where the Axe is Buried* by Ray Nayler and *Empire of AI* by Karen Hao!
- 🎯 My goal is to work in a socially-oriented role where I can use data to build stronger communities
